introHtml: Custom stress relievers balls with carabiner combine the tension-relieving benefits of squishy balls with the convenience of a clip-on attachment. Your team or clients can attach them to backpacks, keychains, or belt loops for on-the-go stress relief. These are ideal for trade shows, employee wellness programs, or safety rewards where portability matters. The carabiner adds functionality that a standard stress ball lacks, making your branded giveaway more likely to be carried and seen daily.
